Lemma
[Orientation-preserving isometries of the hyperbolic plane] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0193 1. ch31:31.2\group Hyperbolic isometries

Every orientation-preserving isometry of $U^2$ is a Mobius transformation \[ z\longmapsto \frac{az+b}{cz+d},\qquad a,b,c,d\in \mathbb R,\quad ad-bc=1. \]
